steps.label: node 0 starts an election

stage.title: Phase 1 · ballot 1.0
stage.about: Prepare and Promise. The proposer asks the acceptors to promise its ballot. It needs promises from a quorum.

steps.says: Node 0 starts an election. Node 0 wants to lead at ballot 1.0. It starts Phase 1.
notes: Node 0's election timeout fires. It waited long enough without hearing from a leader. A timeout is not a safety decision. A timeout costs one round and nothing more.
Node 0 becomes a candidate at ballot 1.0: it wants the whole log suffix.
Node 0 raises its durable promise from 0.0 to 1.0. The promise is durable before anything leaves.
Node 0 campaigns at ballot 1.0. It sends one Prepare to 5 peers, and it claims every slot from 0 at once. Phase 1 asks about no value. It asks what the acceptors have already accepted.

Node 0 asks 5 peers for any slot from 0 it may have missed. It does not claim to be behind. A decision reaches a follower only as a commit watermark. A watermark that it did not receive looks the same as a watermark that was never set.

steps.says: Node 1 promises ballot 1.0. From now on, it refuses every lower ballot.
notes: Node 1 receives Prepare 1.0 for every slot from 0. Its promise was 0.0. It holds 0 accepted records to report.
Node 1 raises its durable promise from 0.0 to 1.0, and reports what it accepted: nothing. Every ballot below 1.0 is fenced out here from now on.

steps.says: Node 0 gets a vote from Node 3. A quorum of the acceptors voted for it, so slot 0 = alpha is chosen. No later ballot can change it.
notes: Node 0 receives an Accepted for slot 0 at 1.0 from node 3. Its round for that slot held 1 vote before this one.

Slot 0 is chosen. 2 of the 6 acceptors voted for alpha at ballot 1.0. A Phase-2 quorum here is one whole column of the 2 by 3 grid. A column holds 2 named acceptors. Every row meets every column in exactly one acceptor. This decision is final. No later ballot can decide this slot differently.
Node 0 applies slot 0 = alpha. Its contiguous prefix now ends at slot 0.

steps.label: node 3 crashes

stage.title: Phase 2 · ballot 1.0
stage.about: Accept and Accepted. The proposer asks the acceptors to vote for one value. When a quorum votes for it, the value is chosen.

steps.says: Node 3 crashes. The disk of Node 3 keeps its promise and its votes. It forgets the rest.
notes: Node 3 crashes. Its disk keeps promise 1.0 and 0 accepted records. Its role, its open rounds, its read rounds and its election timer are gone. Leadership is entirely volatile here, so a crash *is* an abdication and needs no durable fence. Nobody re-sends the Phase-2 rounds that were lost with it.
